android.extraProguardRules:
# react-native-webrtc, @notifee/react-native, expo-notifications, and every
# expo-modules-core-based module (expo-sqlite, expo-video, etc.) already
# bundle their own consumer ProGuard rules via consumerProguardFiles in
# their own build.gradle — confirmed by reading each package's android/
# directory in node_modules, not assumed — so none of those need duplicate
# rules here. expo-sqlite's useSQLCipher mode vendors SQLCipher from C
# source directly into its own native module (see expo-sqlite/android/
# build.gradle's SQLITE3_SRC_DIR) rather than depending on a separate
# net.sqlcipher.* Java package, so the commonly-cited net.sqlcipher.**
# keep rule does not apply to this project's setup and was deliberately
# left out rather than added on the assumption it would.
#
# What's below covers the two dependencies that do NOT bundle their own
# rules and have a documented history of R8-related native-bridge issues:
# react-native-maps' own bridge code (the underlying Play Services Maps
# SDK bundles its own rules, but the com.rnmaps.maps.* bridge classes
# do not), and react-native-incall-manager (no bundled rules at all).
-keep class com.google.android.gms.maps.** { *; }
-keep interface com.google.android.gms.maps.** { *; }
-keep class com.google.android.gms.internal.maps.** { *; }
-keep class com.rnmaps.maps.** { *; }
-keep class com.zxcpoiu.incallmanager.** { *; }
